thread:
incident-bot: ALERT — P0: Elevated 5xx rate observed for inference service in us-east-1. Error % spiked from 0.2% -> 18% at 2026-03-15T09:12Z. Auto-scaling healthy; initial retries increasing latency. Paging oncall.

alice: Paging @ben (oncall) — I see the spike, routing errors to model v2x. Kicking off initial triage. :rotating_light:

ben: oncall here. grabbing logs. can you paste the span IDs? also did autoscaler report any anomalies? thx.

alice: logs: see tail output below. looks like TLS handshake errors for some subset of nodes, followed by backend 502 from router. autoscaler shows pods at 90% CPU but no scale events in last 10m.

alice: ```
2026-03-15T09:11:52Z router-12 ERROR upstream_connect_failed conn_id=0x7f...
2026-03-15T09:11:54Z inference-02 502 Bad Gateway target=v2x-node-3
2026-03-15T09:12:03Z inference-07 WARN kv-cache-miss user=svc-airflow
```

ben: running curl to /health on each node, and `kubectl get pods -o wide` to check node placement.

ben: quick check shows network errors concentrated on nodes in us-east-1c. suspect noisy NIC or host network issue. opening support ticket with GCP now. Jing, tagging you — request urgent NOC escalation for us-east-1c network flaps affecting our instances.

Jing (GCP NOC): Thanks @ben, I see correlated packet drops on the top-of-rack switch in us-east-1c starting 09:10Z. We're opening a hardware replace CR. ETA 20-30m for remediation. I'll push updates to this thread and the cloud incident. Can you confirm affected instance IDs?

ben: affected instances: rwd-inference-us-east-1-a-03, -07, -11 (these host model v2x partitions). We're bringing up fallback routing to other AZs.

dmitri: re-routing plan — shifting traffic away from 1c to 1a/1b. Applying temporary routing policy now: set region_az_blacklist: [us-east-1c] for inference service. Deploying policy in 2m.

alice: drafting status page copy. propose:

"Investigating: We are experiencing elevated error rates for inference requests in us-east-1. Affected customers may see increased latency or 5xx errors. Our engineers are working with the cloud provider on a fix. Next update by 09:40Z."

carol: +1 to that. also we should include mitigation steps customers can take (retry, failover to dedicated pools). I'll add link to docs.

ben: implemented routing policy. traffic to 1c dropped to 0 within 90s. initial metrics show 5xx rate falling from 18% -> 3% in 4 minutes. continuing to monitor.

incident-bot: NOTE: Oncall handover scheduled at 09:30Z. @carol will take incident lead at that time.

ben: handoff summary for carol:
- root cause: network hardware issue in us-east-1c (GCP confirmed)
- mitigation: region_az_blacklist applied, traffic shifted to 1a/1b
- customer impact: transient 5xx and latency for requests routed to us-east-1c between 09:10-09:18Z. ~12% of requests saw errors during peak
- next steps: monitor, coordinate with GCP for host replacement, restore capacity and remove blacklist once stable

carol: taking over. thx @ben. I'll coordinate status updates and customer comms. ben — can you keep the GCP bridge open and post updates from Jing?

Jing (GCP NOC): Hardware replacement started 09:28Z. we'll validate and run connectivity tests once switchover completes. I'll post packet loss graphs and timeline in 10m.

carol: drafting customer notification (short version):

"We experienced transient inference errors for customers using the us-east region due to a cloud provider network disruption affecting a single availability zone. We routed traffic away from the affected AZ and errors have largely subsided. We are monitoring and will provide another update in 30 minutes. If you see persistent failures, please reply to this message or open a support ticket."

carol: internal comms template for support org:

"Incident P0 — US-EAST AZ network disruption impacting inference. Mitigation: traffic redirected from us-east-1c. Current status: error rate reduced to ~3%, no impact to paid SLA observed; we are tracking host replacement with GCP. Contact: carol (incident lead), ben (oncall primary)."

dmitri: ops-notify-bot queued status page update. command:
```bash
ops-notify-bot update --component=inference --status=investigating --message='Elevated 5xx errors in us-east; traffic rerouted from affected AZ; working with cloud provider.' --eta='09:40Z'
```

ops-notify-bot: Status page updated: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/1918204567 (auto-generated)

ben: quick ask for SRE: capture pcap from one affected host and upload to secure bucket for GCP review. command used:

```bash
sudo tcpdump -i eth0 -w /tmp/us-east-1c-flap.pcap
gsutil cp /tmp/us-east-1c-flap.pcap gs://rwd-incident-artifacts/1918204567/
```

alice: reaction :thumbsup: — good call. I'll attach logs and topology map to the incident doc.

Jing (GCP NOC): Replacement complete 09:54Z. initial connectivity tests OK, packet loss dropped to baseline. We'll continue to monitor and will keep you posted after 1h of stable metrics.

carol: rolling back region_az_blacklist in 10m if metrics remain stable. timeline: 09:55Z re-test, 10:05Z restore, 10:15Z confirm.

ben: post-mortem checklist added to incident doc: timeline, customer impact estimation, mitigations, follow-up action for autoscaler sensitivity to NIC flaps.

carol: final customer update draft:

"Update: The cloud provider replaced network hardware in the affected availability zone. We rerouted traffic during remediation and error rates have returned to normal. If you experienced failures between 09:10-09:20Z, we recommend retrying any failed requests; persistent issues, please contact support. We will publish a full post-incident report within 48 hours."

carol: tagging communications: @support-team please hold on sending templated emails until I paste the final copy here. ops will push status page resolved when we confirm baseline.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE — severity remains P0 until rollback verified. Next auto-check 10:05Z.

ben: closing notes — will follow up on host artifacts and hand over to reliability for postmortem. great cross-team response. :clap:

carol: thanks all. I'll post postmortem draft in incidents channel once we have the full timeline and artifacts. closing this vendor coordination thread after final status page resolve.
